title.narrative: Desarrollo Turstico de la Franja Costera
Touristic Development of the Coastal Zone

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es incrementar los ingresos y el empleo formal en la franja costero-marina, en particular para poblacin vulnerable, a travs del desarrollo productivo del sector turstico. El objetivo especfico es incrementar el gasto turstico en La Libertad y Baha Jiquilisco a travs de la consolidacin y diversificacin de modalidades de turismo de ocio.

The overall objective of the program is to increase income and formal employment in the coastal marine zone, particularly for vulnerable populations, through the productive development of the tourism sector. The specific objective is to increase tourist spending in La Libertad and Jiquilisco Bay through the consolidation and diversification of forms of leisure tourism.
